source.title: OS OpenMap–Local official OpenData documentation / Exeter sample source window
source.source_window_hash_basis: canonical observed official Ordnance Survey OS OpenMap–Local product/documentation text and OS Downloads API authentication documentation; not raw downloadable Exeter sample feature bytes

evidence_slice: Ordnance Survey's official OS OpenMap–Local documentation states that the OpenData product provides vector building features, contains important buildings and functional sites, and uses generalised building geometries derived from OS MasterMap large-scale data. The documentation also states that Exeter is one of the free sample areas and that OS OpenData endpoints of the Downloads API do not require an API key. However, the selected official documentation/sample window does not expose a record-level feature payload directly bound to NHLE List Entry 1223756 (Roman Catholic Church of the Sacred Heart), nor a direct official identifier relationship tying an OS OpenMap–Local building polygon to that NHLE record. Establishing the church-to-building polygon relationship would therefore require a spatial join or external matching step, which is reserved for local OpenCode; no parcel-progress or building record is accepted from source-area metadata alone.

field_evidence.footprint: Official OS OpenMap–Local documentation confirms generalised building geometries derived from OS MasterMap large-scale data.
field_evidence.type_use: Official OS OpenMap–Local documentation confirms important buildings and functional sites, but the selected source window does not expose a record-bound type/use feature for NHLE 1223756.
field_evidence.identity: The selected official OS source window provides an Exeter sample area but no direct identifier relationship binding an OS building polygon to NHLE List Entry 1223756.
